name: wishfinity
description: Save any product link to your Wishfinity wishlist.

interface.longDescription: Wishfinity +W saves any product to your universal Wishfinity wishlist. Share a product page link and +W returns a link that saves it to wishfinity.com, where you can find it again, sort it into lists, and share it with friends and family. It works with any store; Wishfinity looks up the product's name, description, image and price itself when the link is opened. People without an account can sign up when they open the link.
capabilities: Save a product link to a Wishfinity wishlist
